title: good size, works great
text: good size, works great. I have several tea cups/mugs and I bought these specifically for drinking genmacha (japanese toasted rice tea).  They work perfectly with any loose tea.  I find the larger mug size perfect as I drink a LOT of tea!  I also love all the colors.  Everyone can keep track of their mug throughout the day.  Dishwasher safe and does beautifully on the top rack.  Love it.

product_metadata.title: FORLIFE Curve Tall Tea Mug with Infuser and Lid, 15-Ounce, Blue
features: Tall Tea Mug with an extra-fine 0.3 mm hole stainless-steel infuser
Turn the lid upside down, it works as an infuser holder
Material: Mug/Lid - lead-free high-fired ceramic, Tea infuser - stainless steel
description: FORLIFE Curve Tall Tea Mug, complete with an extra-fine 0.3 mm hole stainless-steel infuser and lid, is designed for simple and clean way of steeping just one fresh cup of tea in your own cup. The extra-fine tea infuser gives you a perfect even steep every time and enables you to steep fine loose-leaf teas such as Rooibos tea to large whole-leaf teas like Oolong tea. To make your desired tea, simply take the infuser out from the teacup when tea steeped at right timing. Turn the lid upside-down, it works as an infuser holder.
